data.name: Settings_StartOverNote
data.value: Erases everything on this phone and goes back to the first screen, where you can set up a factory again or choose "I'm a worker".

data.name: Settings_StartOverOwnerText
data.value:
This erases the factory, all workers, saree entries, payments and history from this phone. It can't be undone.
Export your data first (Settings → Export all data) if you may need it again.
Workers' phones linked to this phone stop syncing; link them again afterwards.

data.name: Settings_StartOverWorkerText
data.value: This erases your entries and earnings from this phone and unlinks it from the owner. The owner's phone keeps everything. It can't be undone.

data.name: Login_ForgotWorker
data.value: Ask the owner to tap "Link phone" for you again and scan the new QR code. You then choose a new PIN, and your history comes back.

data.name: Login_ForgotNoLock
data.value:
This phone has no screen lock, so the app can't check that it is you.
Set a screen lock (Android Settings → Security), then tap "Forgot PIN?" again.
Or, to erase this phone and start over: Android Settings → Apps → Handloom Factory → Storage → Clear data.

data.name: Login_ForgotUnlock
data.value: Unlock with your phone's screen lock to choose a new app PIN
